in_sanskrit.name: राम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who brings delight, pleasure, joy, love, and peace. The name of the seventh avatar of Lord Vishnu, who is considered an ideal man, husband, and king.

in_tamil.name: ராம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஆராத்து வரும் வருங்குதல்லோர், அருந்தல் அல்லவையால் வழிக்கும் ஆண் இல்லோர்

in_telugu.name: రామ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: ఆరాధ్య యోజనే, ప్రీయ యోజనే, జీవయ యోజనే

in_marathi.name: Ram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's Name, Strength
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ram is the name of the seventh avatar of Vishnu, a deity in Hindu mythology. The story of Ram is one of the most well-known in Hinduism, recounted in the ancient Indian epic Ramayana. Ram is known for his strength, courage, and unwavering loyalty to his wife, Sita. He is considered an ideal man and a role model for Hindus.

He is considered an ideal man and a role model for Hindus.
